ROUTE_IDENTITY.finding: Route contract, guidance specification and output all identify GA retroactive First Offender treatment under §42-8-66; this stage is pre-consent guidance.

SOURCE_IDENTITY.finding: All relied-on committed authority records are bound by exact source-receipt hashes; this stage has no Master Library binary source.

COMPONENT_SET.finding: Rendered artifacts and field map contain exactly the two declared components: participant factual record and process guidance.

KNOWN_PREFILLS.finding: Only participant identity/contact facts are written to the factual record; nine route facts remain participant-supplied blanks.

REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING.finding: The nine factual questions and consent-stage actions are stated; nothing is represented as filed.

ROUTE_OPTIONS.finding: Written prosecutorial consent is a prerequisite; silence, refusal, unanswered request and no-known-objection do not satisfy it.

REPEATING_ROWS.finding: No repeated filing rows are generated; the factual record questions are individually represented.

PROTECTED_FIELDS.finding: Signature/date and all participant factual responses remain blank; no prosecutorial consent is fabricated or written.

ARTIFACTS.finding: Canonical and boundary assembled PDFs are present and byte-hashed; completeness counters report all nine zero.

PAGE_ORDER.finding: Both assembled fixtures contain factual-record pages first and process-guidance pages second, matching component order.

CLIPPING_AND_OVERLAP.finding: Directly viewed all ten original PNG pages from central run 34575955732 (five canonical and five boundary). Text is legible and page content is fully within bounds; no clipping, overlap, stray ink or crop defect observed.

FILING_DESTINATION.finding: Guidance directs the participant to the prosecuting attorney first and convicting court only after written consent; nothing is filed in this stage.

FEE_AND_WAIVER.finding: The guidance states the statutory no-filing-fee treatment for §42-8-66 and does not invent a waiver artifact.

SERVICE.finding: No service occurs before consent; post-consent petition service belongs to the separate petition family.

SELF_HELP_STOP.finding: Consent negotiation, contested hearing, immigration consequences and other recorded boundaries are directed to legal help/referral desks.
